answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. What survives to the oasis is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Work waits on the nadir until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the summit of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
